question: What knowledge leaves nothing further to be known?
premises: Lord speaks knowledge with direct knowledge
knowing it leaves nothing to know
fixity in knowledge and action remains
inference: Complete knowledge is paired with direct realization and action.
uncertainties: long fused compound analyzed as one row
plain_english: I will speak to you this knowledge with direct knowledge completely; having known it, nothing remains to be known, since in knowledge and action nothing of the knowable remains, because of fixity in knowledge and action.
